questions.question: To escape Saul, where did David go to live?
options: Among the Philistines, with King Achish
Across the Jordan in the hills of Gilead
In the wilderness strongholds of Engedi
In the land of Moab, with its king
questions.answer: Among the Philistines, with King Achish

questions.question: What town did Achish give David to live in?
David lived in Philistine territory about a year and four months.
